name: Notejoy
description_en:
Notejoy is a shared note workspace built around libraries, notebooks, tags and fast retrieval. It supports mixed content, real-time editing, discussions and links between notes, with paid tiers adding offline use, recovery and more storage.

The important distinction is between a free collaborative library and a paid library with the storage, permission and safety tools required by a production team. A general feature page does not mean every feature is free.
description_zh:
Notejoy 是围绕资料库、笔记本、标签与快速检索构建的共享笔记工作区，支持混合内容、实时编辑、讨论及笔记关联；付费档增加离线使用、恢复和更大存储。

应区分免费协作资料库与具备正式团队所需存储、权限和保护工具的付费资料库。通用功能页列出某项能力，不代表免费方案也包含。

core_features.explanation_en: Separate libraries with nested notebooks, tags and backlinks.
core_features.explanation_zh: 以资料库、嵌套笔记本、标签和反向链接组织团队知识。

core_features.explanation_en: Collaborative editing, threaded discussion and mentions are documented.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档列有协作编辑、串联讨论与提及。

core_features.explanation_en: History, deletion recovery and bulk export depend on paid tiers.
core_features.explanation_zh: 历史、删除恢复及批量导出依赖付费档。

en: Maintain a shared procedure with comments and linked references.
zh: 通过评论及关联参考维护共享流程。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Vendor account workspace with device sync; offline is paid-tier dependent.
Deployment.zh: 提供设备同步的厂商账户工作区；离线能力依赖付费档。

steps.en: Create a library and procedure notebook with a representative attachment.
steps.zh: 创建资料库和流程笔记本，加入代表性附件。

steps.en: Invite a collaborator and verify the intended edit/comment permission on the selected plan.
steps.zh: 邀请协作者，核对所选套餐的编辑／评论权限。

steps.en: Test paid history/export if these are required for the archive.
steps.zh: 若归档需要历史／导出，应测试对应付费功能。

items.en: The feature page documents restoring from note history, recovering deleted notes and bulk export to Google Drive; the pricing page places these on paid tiers. Test a disposable deletion/export before moving the only copy of a team knowledge base. Embedded third-party documents retain their own access requirements. Notejoy suits shared procedures and discussion better than a chat-only archive, but no integration execution, encryption audit, customer restore time, self-hosted edition or open-source licence was verified.
items.zh: 功能页说明可恢复笔记历史、找回删除笔记，以及批量导出至 Google Drive；定价页将其列于付费档。迁移团队知识库的唯一副本前，应测试临时删除和导出。嵌入的第三方文档仍有其自身访问条件。Notejoy 适合共享流程和讨论，不宜仅视作聊天归档；未验证集成执行、加密审计、客户恢复时限、自行部署版或开源许可。

pricing.billing_basis: Solo or per-user Pro; Team flat subscription with unlimited users.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Solo $5/month annual; Pro $10/user/month annual or $15 monthly; Team $100/month annual or $150 monthly. Free has small library/file limits.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Solo 年付折算每月 5；Pro 年付折算每用户每月 10 或按月 15；Team 年付折算每月 100 或按月 150。免费资料库／文件限额较小。

English and Chinese carry matching amounts, billing periods, qualifications and unknowns.
Historical directory assertions are superseded, including unverified feature and API labels.

sections.title_en: Keep a team procedure and its discussion together
sections.title_zh: 把团队流程与讨论放在一起
sections.en: For an illustrative support handover, create a notebook for procedures, write a checklist with embedded reference files, link related notes and ask colleagues to comment with mentions. Team libraries separate working contexts; nested notebooks/tags and backlinks support retrieval. The features page also documents web clipping and email forwarding. Check who can view or comment before using a shared library for client-specific material.
sections.zh: 例如交接支持工作时，可为流程创建笔记本，写带参考文件的检查清单，关联相关笔记，再请同事通过提及参与评论。团队资料库分离工作语境，嵌套笔记本／标签及反向链接帮助检索。功能页还列网页采集和邮件转入。存放特定客户资料前，应先核对谁可以查看或评论。

sections.title_en: Match library size to permissions and recovery
sections.title_zh: 让资料库规模匹配权限与恢复条件
sections.en: Free permits five users per library, three team libraries, five notebooks, 10 MB files and 100 MB library storage. The page states that all plans include unlimited device sync and real-time collaborative editing. Solo adds offline access, OCR search, history, export and deleted-note recovery but permits only one user per library. Pro adds view/comment-only users; Team adds user management and a team activity dashboard. These are separate buying constraints, not interchangeable feature labels.
sections.zh: Free 允许每资料库五用户、三个团队资料库、五个笔记本、单文件 10 MB、资料库存储 100 MB。页面说明所有方案均包含不限设备同步和实时协作编辑。Solo 增加离线、OCR 搜索、历史、导出和删除恢复，但每资料库仅一用户。Pro 增加仅查看／评论用户；Team 增加用户管理与团队活动看板。这些是不同采购条件，不能当作可互换功能标签。

sections.title_zh: 按用户与不限用户计费不同
sections.en: Solo is displayed at $5/month billed annually, Pro at $10/user/month annually or $15 monthly, and Team at $100/month annually or $150 monthly with unlimited users. Solo lists 5 GB library storage and 100 MB uploads; Pro lists 20 GB and 1 GB uploads. Unlimited users does not mean unlimited storage. The retrieved pricing page does not establish a time-limited paid trial, tax treatment or regional currency, so these remain page snapshots.
sections.zh: Solo 显示年付折算每月 5；Pro 年付折算每用户每月 10，按月 15；Team 年付折算每月 100，按月 150，不限用户。Solo 列出每资料库 5 GB、单文件 100 MB；Pro 为 20 GB、单文件 1 GB。不限用户不等于不限存储。读取的定价页未确认限时付费试用、税费或地区币种，因此这些金额保留为页面快照。

sections.title_en: Check note recovery and external references
sections.title_zh: 检查笔记恢复与外部引用
sections.en: The feature page documents restoring from note history, recovering deleted notes and bulk export to Google Drive; the pricing page places these on paid tiers. Test a disposable deletion/export before moving the only copy of a team knowledge base. Embedded third-party documents retain their own access requirements. Notejoy suits shared procedures and discussion better than a chat-only archive, but no integration execution, encryption audit, customer restore time, self-hosted edition or open-source licence was verified.
sections.zh: 功能页说明可恢复笔记历史、找回删除笔记，以及批量导出至 Google Drive；定价页将其列于付费档。迁移团队知识库的唯一副本前，应测试临时删除和导出。嵌入的第三方文档仍有其自身访问条件。Notejoy 适合共享流程和讨论，不宜仅视作聊天归档；未验证集成执行、加密审计、客户恢复时限、自行部署版或开源许可。

research_gaps.en: Trial availability, regional billing, live integrations, actual encryption boundaries and recovery/export fidelity were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核实试用、地区账单、真实集成、实际加密边界与恢复／导出保真度。
